paragraphs.text:
Few researchers have had to make such a desperate decision. It 
is natural that you hesitate. Alas, while you do, the man with 
the  blade  swings  it  with  surprising  strength.  Bernard  barely 
makes a sound. His head drops to the moss carpet beneath his 
body and rolls aside.

Make a Sanity roll: if you succeed, go to 239; if you fail, lose 1D6 
Sanity and go to 238.
